summary: 014 implements the approved Formal Full Test model almost completely and passes all ordinary regression/engineering/OpenSpec gates, but candidate drift is detected only after the entire remaining check loop. An independent two-check probe proves that after check A mutates tracked repository state, check B still executes before stopped-candidate-drift is returned, violating the approved immediate-STOP rule. Revise locally to re-derive candidate after each executed check and stop before later checks. The Author Run also records 205/205 domain tests while the exact candidate reproducibly runs 206/206; fresh revise-apply verification must record exact evidence.
